independent_review.verbatim:
**Two distinct source-only candidates: Bat placement and egg-impact hatching.** The Chicken egg-laying timer stays with its accepted legacy owner and adds **zero** to the egg verdict. No formal intake. [Reviewed receipt](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-bat-calendar-and-egg-impact-birth-source-review-20261125.json:503)

**Bat calendar and shade — 1 candidate.** `Bat.java:199–219` rejects positions at or above sea level. From **October 20 through November 3**, inclusive, `LocalDate.now()` in the JVM’s default zone selects `nextInt(7)`. Outside that window, a boolean rejects half the calls before `nextInt(4)`. Both branches require raw brightness at or below the draw, then run the inherited floor check. At brightness 0 the callback passes **1 vs. ½** of draws, at brightness 3 **4/7 vs. 1/8**, and at brightness 6 **1/7 vs. 0**, assuming the floor passes. This date branch changes the brightness distribution and its upper limit. Slime reads the **world moon** alongside its separate chunk rule. Guardian waives a **sky-exposure veto** on one draw in twenty. Bat roosting is downstream behavior and earns no separate credit. [Bat predicate](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/ambient/Bat.java:199) · [Slime comparison](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-slime-chunk-and-moon-native-source-review-20261126.json:327) · [Guardian comparison](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-guardian-underwater-sky-native-placement-source-review-20261126.json:210)

**Egg-impact juveniles — 1 candidate, with material production excluded.** `EggItem.java:17–32` requests a player-launched projectile and then consumes one egg outside `instabuild`. The dispenser also requests launch before shrinking one (`DispenseItemBehavior.java:112–118`, `AbstractProjectileDispenseBehavior.java:13–20`). Neither checks the projectile-add result. A qualifying server impact reaches `ThrownEgg.java:43–64` only after normal projectile dispatch and Forge’s `DEFAULT` impact result. The **1-in-8** roll opens hatching, then **1-in-32** selects four factory attempts instead of one. The exact distribution for **0, 1, or 4 attempts** is **224/256, 31/256, and 1/256**. Nonnull chickens get age `-24000` at the projectile pose and separate unchecked add requests. The projectile discards on normal return. This path calls neither natural placement nor `finalizeSpawn`. [Player launch](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/item/EggItem.java:17) · [Egg impact](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/projectile/ThrownEgg.java:43)

Legacy `712005e1eef0d9d5e673` already owns `EggLayTime` and the living-adult, non-jockey laying cycle. The projectile holds no link to that layer. EA-0017 owns offspring from a scheduled water-surface egg block. EA-0035 owns a travel projectile whose optional encounter occurs at the owner’s origin before teleportation. Here the impact itself requests juveniles at the projectile position, including through a dispenser. [Legacy laying owner](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/legacy-migration-acceptance/reviewed.jsonl:593) · [EA-0017](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/batch-011.json:6) · [EA-0035](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/batch-026.json:23)
